source_tradition: The Monroe Institute / Gateway Focus ladder
policy: Focus levels are retained as Gateway program concepts, not promoted to universal consciousness phases.
No Focus level receives an identity mapping to Nova.
Metaphysical descriptions attached to a Focus level do not justify an NC mapping.
Only a narrow phenomenological overlap is mapped when the source wording supports it.

concepts.label: Focus 3 — coherent/synchronized/balanced mind-brain condition
source_basis: Wave I Discovery instructions — Orientation / Focus 3
concepts.notes: Early Gateway training state described in program terms.

concepts.label: Focus 10 — mind awake, body asleep
concepts.notes: Maintained mental alertness with deeply relaxed/sleeping body.

concepts.label: Focus 12 — expanded awareness
concepts.notes: Broad Gateway exploration state; its program definition does not collapse to one NC concept.

concepts.label: Focus 15 — no time
concepts.notes: Gateway describes this as a no-time state and a state of stillness/simply being.

concepts.label: Focus 21 — bridge to other energy/reality systems
concepts.notes: Program concept strongly bound to Gateway's nonphysical-system cosmology.

concepts.label: Focus 27 — reception center between physical lives
source_basis: Wave VII Voyager — Intro to Focus 27

mappings.basis: Nova currently has no canonical node corresponding to Gateway's program-defined coherent/synchronized/balanced Focus 3 condition.
mappings.warning: Do not manufacture an NC state merely to complete the ladder.

mappings.basis: Both retain awareness while the body enters a sleep-like/deeply relaxed condition, but Focus 10 is a program state and NC Endormissement conscient is a transition/process concept.
mappings.warning: Focus 10 is not identical to Endormissement conscient.

mappings.basis: Gateway's 'expanded awareness' is intentionally broad and combines program state, exploratory stance and source-specific interpretations. No single NC concept captures that unit.
mappings.warning: Do not map Focus 12 to generic Lucidité simply because both involve awareness.

mappings.basis: Gateway defines Focus 15 through a subjective 'no time' framing; NC Distorsion du temps models subjective temporal alteration. The overlap is limited to temporal phenomenology, not Gateway's claims about being beyond time and space.
mappings.warning: The metaphysical claim that an energy body is not limited by time and space is excluded from this mapping.

mappings.basis: Focus 21 is defined by Gateway as a bridge to other energy/reality systems. Nova has phenomenological transition and projection concepts but no canonical cosmological 'bridge' node.
mappings.warning: Do not map a source-specific cosmological location/state to Zone de bascule or Projection lucide.

mappings.basis: Focus 27 is described as a reception center between physical lives; this is outside the current Nova phenomenological ontology and is source-specific metaphysical framing.
source_basis: Wave VII Voyager — Intro to Focus 27
mappings.warning: No NC equivalent should be created absent a separate, explicitly interpretive/cosmological layer.
